name: westwood_online_upgrade_config_dialog_do_data_exchange
description: WestwoodOnlineUpgradeConfigDialog::DoDataExchange binds the WOL config dialog combo, edit, connect-string CString, and remember-password flag through MFC DDX providers.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
The method is a provider-backed MFC DDX wrapper; the smoke verifies imported provider call order and arguments rather than running live dialog data exchange.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4419a0 validates the provider call sequence: DDX_Control for control ids 1192 and 1173 using member offsets 0x60 and 0xa0, DDX_Text(CString&) for control id 1173 using member offset 0xe4, and DDX_Check for control id 1182 using member offset 0xe8.

Native smoke westwood_online_upgrade_config_dialog_do_data_exchange_smoke patches the MFC42 DDX provider imports and verifies call order, control ids, the shared CDataExchange pointer, and each bound member address.
